title: The porter learns loader API changes from the loaders' own code
text: Since #127 the link check counts the loader's API, and 148 mods are held back only by the loader (FMLEnvironment.dist in 1.21.9, the 1.20.5 payload and config-screen APIs, Fabric API networking). The learner's snapshots now carry the loader as a mod runs on it, the classes the link check reads: NeoForge's universal jar with FML and its other net.neoforged libraries, or Fabric Loader with Fabric API's modules, in Mojang names. The loader's own code uses its own API, so a change to it is learned like the game's. Also: a one-line static wrapper and its body are one reading, and a bare call with no operands has nothing to check a pairing by (why RenderSystem.disableBlend() in 1.21.5 and enableTexture() in 1.19.4 stayed unlearned).
finish: port.jar-links.every-update up from 5,846 with no update lower except named false links, and load on NeoForge 1.20.4 -> 1.20.5 and 1.21.8 -> 1.21.9 (server and client) showing every linked standalone mod loads
wrongIf: an update's count drops for a mod that works, or a mod that links only through a learned loader replacement fails to load because of it
result: 2026-11-20: port.jar-links.every-update 5,846 -> 5,865 of 9,423, every update reading the same mods, none lower; mods held back only by the loader 148 -> 132. NeoForge 1.21.8 -> 1.21.9 28 -> 35 (FMLEnvironment.dist is FMLLoader.getCurrent().getDist(), learned from FML's own code), Fabric 1.21.11 -> 26.1 32 -> 36, Fabric 1.19.3 -> 1.19.4 56 -> 59 (enableTexture() dropped). Real NeoForge 1.21.9 server: the 6 standalone mods this newly links all load (18 of 22 in all; FerriteCore fails as on main). Real 1.20.5: server 12 of 13, client 11 of 12, the same link set as main (Euphoria Patcher needs Commons Compress, which only the client has; Yeetus Experimentus has a @ModifyVariable on WorldOpenFlows.loadLevel, which 1.20.5 changed). The 1.21.9 client can't be proven yet: even an empty NeoForge 21.9 pack ends in a broken mod state in pack-check's client, without the game's asset files. Not learned: the 1.20.5 NeoForge payload, config-screen and display-test APIs and Fabric's payload registries are redesigns (new registration types, lambdas of another interface), with no loader code that lines up.
